verdict.rationale: Temporal's first-party self-hosted guide documents deploying a production-ready Temporal Service via Docker, Kubernetes, or manual setup, with self-hosted guidance on namespaces, archival, and multi-cluster replication; the open-source GitHub repo also provides pre-built images and a local dev server. One community user reports thin self-hosting documentation, which lowers quality but does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of production self-hosting, deeper self-hosting operational documentation (a community report calls it sparse)
